finetune.purpose: The stronger field fine-tune, started if v1 does not improve on the field validation set by 2.4 M (your call, 2026-09-28). v1 lifted the field score 0.48 -> 0.54 by 2.1 M and then held at 0.54 / 0.54 / 0.52 (2.2 M, 2.3 M) with SAC's entropy coefficient at 0.0025. v2 starts from v1's best checkpoint and pushes harder on the field layouts, on the cases that fail most, with more exploration.
finetune.encounter_weights_basis: each case's mean failure rate on the field validation set at 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3 M (supervisor off): HO 0.65, BO 0.64, CRS 0.59, OT 0.39, CRP 0.36, NT 0.22 -- NT raised to 0.45 so no-target layouts stay ~15 % of field episodes (passing every no-target run is a hard requirement)
finetune.selection: as v1: best goal - 2 x collision over the development set (120) plus the field validation set (155), supervisor off; v1's best model is evaluated first and kept if nothing beats it
finetune.field_training: src/field_training.py revision 1.0, encounters drawn by encounter_weights; generated ahead in a background thread (prefetch) so a reset never waits
finetune.test: unchanged: the Paper 2 deployment-layout set and the frozen suite, neither seen in training or selection
